stories.headline: Colombia's Operation Tridente reports about 10 tonnes of cocaine and 6.4 tonnes of marijuana taken on the Pacific coast
stories.body: President Abelardo de la Espriella announced the results of a Navy and Marine operation run with US Southern Command's interagency task force under a strategy called Escudo de las Américas. Forces destroyed 37 coca-paste labs, stopped about six vessels, raided three collection points and held 20 people; the government put the value near US$500 million. The announcement dates to 17 November and does not give the dates the operation was carried out.

stories.headline: Europe-wide raids on an Ecuador-to-Europe cocaine network lead to about 50 detentions and 2.3 million Swiss francs seized
stories.body: Searches on 10 and 11 November across Switzerland, Germany, the Czech Republic, the Netherlands and Spain targeted a group that allegedly hid cocaine from Ecuador in fruit shipments and laundered proceeds through front companies. Switzerland held 41 people, Germany five, and a senior figure was arrested on Gran Canaria; Europol and Eurojust assisted. Investigators also took 15 weapons and cryptocurrency, and tie the network to a 750 kg Antwerp seizure in August.
